task.summary:
Refactor code structure for improved readability and maintainability feat: Implement UART communication and protocol handling
- Added Uart_Communicate.cpp and Uart_Communicate.h for host protocol dispatch and command handling. - Introduced HostCommandPublisher and HostTelemetryPublisher classes for managing commands and telemetry data. - Implemented HostProtocol class to dispatch incoming UART frames to appropriate commands. - Created uart_driver.cpp for UART driver functionality, including DMA handling and frame parsing. - Updated uart_driver.h to define UART port structures and function prototypes. - Modified wave_control.h and pid.c to include C++ compatibility. - Enhanced CMakeLists.txt to support C++17 and mixed C/C++ compilation. - Adjusted FreeRTOSConfig.h to optimize heap size for better memory management. - Revised program architecture documentation to reflect new C++ structure and design goals.

feat(pressure): Add eye-specific target window filtering
- Add target window filtering for treatment pressure control - Support separate pressure profiles for single-eye and dual-eye modes - Update treatment task flow to apply filtered target behavior

docs(system): Document application runtime setup
- Add comments for shared runtime state and FreeRTOS queues - Describe application initialization and task creation responsibilities - Document RTOS failure hooks and safety shutdown behavior
